verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO keys are hardware authenticators (FIDO2/U2F, PIV, OTP). They are not a service or platform that hosts resources or exposes an API for which scoped, least-privilege credentials could be issued to an agent, so this axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product issuing permission-scoped API tokens, and the OpenAPI probe found no API at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
